env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

env CC=

[cgo] env CGO_ENABLED=2
[cgo] ! logos build .
[cgo] stderr '\[restriction::cgo_usage\]'

[cgo] env CGO_ENABLED=1
[cgo] logos run .
[cgo] stdout '^env: 42$'

import "C"
